agents.title: Agents & automation
agents.subtitle: How far each governed agent may act. The server enforces every ceiling — this page only reflects it.
agents.banner: Every agent is capped at suggest — the ceiling can be lowered but never raised past human approval.

ceiling.label: Ceiling
ceiling.locked: Locked at {level} — the server enforces this cap

levelHint.suggest: The agent drafts a suggestion; a human decides.
levelHint.approve: The agent proposes; a human must approve before it acts.
levelHint.auto: The agent acts without human approval.

agentConfig.title: Agents
agentConfig.subtitle: Each agent is a governed container, never a source of authority. Its level can only lower what the tool and role ceilings already allow — the server enforces the cap.

ledger.title: Action ledger
ledger.subtitle: Every recorded agent interaction, newest first — drafts, approvals, rejections and fence refusals.
ledger.empty: No agent interactions have been recorded yet.
ledger.footnote: A read-only view of the append-only interaction ledger. Rows cannot be edited or deleted — the table is immutable in the ORM and by database triggers.

agentConfig.empty: No governed agents are registered for this tenant.

hero.metricsNote: Every metric is a real count from the interaction ledger and the approval queue. A metric with no data yet shows —, never a placeholder number.

pipeline.title: How this agent acts
pipeline.subtitle: Every run follows the same governed path — the ceiling is checked before anything leaves the agent, and the fence is never crossed.

ladder.title: Autonomy
ladder.subtitle: Choose how far this agent may act. Only levels at or below its effective ceiling are selectable; higher rungs are locked and enforced in code.
ladder.locked: Unavailable — capped at {level} for the tools this agent touches (enforced server-side).
ladder.forgedNote: The ceiling is enforced on the server: a request for a higher level is clamped to the ceiling on save, and the runtime caps it again at call time.

pauseToggle.title: Agent status
pauseToggle.help: A paused agent takes no action at all — every tool call resolves to off until it is resumed.

limits.title: Rate & timing limits
limits.subtitle: Real limits the runtime reads. A limit can only stop the agent and hand the work to a human — it never widens autonomy.
limits.maxDraftsHint: Once the agent has drafted this many in a rolling hour, it stops until the window clears. Blank = no cap.
limits.quietHoursHint: The agent does not act during this window; the work waits for a human.

escalation.title: Escalate uncertainty to a human
escalation.help: The safety hand-off: when the agent is uncertain — a clinical question, a non-groundable draft — it stops and flags a human. This is enforced in code and cannot be turned off.
escalation.thresholdPlanned: planned — the runtime has no confidence score yet, so no adjustable threshold is shown rather than a control that changes nothing. The mandatory hand-off above stays on regardless.

create.title: New agent
create.subtitle: Create a governed agent of a real kind. It is capped from birth — its autonomy can never exceed the ceiling of the tools it touches.
create.name: Name
create.cappedNote: The new agent starts at Suggest and is whitelisted to its kind's real tools. The server caps it to the same ceilings as every other agent — it cannot be created above any ceiling.

whitelist.title: Tools it may call
whitelist.lockedReason: Outside this agent's remit — it cannot be enabled here.
whitelist.ceilingNote: Capped at {level} — enabling never raises a tool past its ceiling.
whitelist.forgedNote: Enabling changes which tools the agent may call, never a tool's ceiling. A request to enable a locked or unknown tool is dropped on the server, and each tool is still capped at run time.

mirror.title: Permission ceiling
mirror.subtitle: The real RBAC permissions this agent can and cannot exercise. It reflects the roles — it does not set them.
mirror.caption: Inherited from the role, and re-checked against the operator's role when an action is approved. To change the ceiling, change the role:

fence.title: Electric fence
fence.subtitle: Enforced in code and locked by the evaluation harness. There is no switch here — these cannot be turned off.
fence.footnote: These invariants are asserted by the agent evaluation suite; this card displays them, it cannot change them.

ai_labelled.title: AI output is labelled
ai_labelled.detail: Every interaction is recorded as "AI draft — requires human review"; the label is forced, not caller-set.

human_approves_send.title: A human approves before anything is sent
human_approves_send.detail: Agents draft only; sending requires a human sender at approve time. No tool sends autonomously.

clinical_reviewed.title: Clinical work is never autonomous
clinical_reviewed.detail: Clinical and financial actions can never exceed "approve"; diagnosis, triage and dosing requests are refused, never drafted.

consent_scoped.title: Access is consent- and tenant-scoped
consent_scoped.detail: Every record is tenant-scoped fail-closed; messaging is blocked until the patient's consent is on file.

immutable_ledger.title: The ledger is append-only
immutable_ledger.detail: The audit and interaction logs block UPDATE and DELETE in the ORM and by database triggers; the hash-chain is verifiable.

reground_at_approve.title: Approval re-authorises and re-grounds
reground_at_approve.detail: Approving re-checks the tool permission and re-derives the draft from live state before it acts — an edit is not a bypass.

allergyAlert.title: Recorded allergies
allergyAlert.subtitle: Documented by a clinician. These are recorded facts — CareOS surfaces them, it does not compute drug-allergy conflicts.

seam.title: Automated medication-safety checking
seam.notConfigured: No automated medication-safety checking is configured. Recorded allergies are shown above; drug-allergy interaction, cross-reactivity and contraindication checking is a certified-partner function and is not performed here.
seam.configuredNoFindings: A medication-safety partner is connected. It runs advisory checks at prescribing time; there is nothing to show on this record view.
seam.footnote: When a licensed partner is connected, its findings appear here as advisory notes for the prescriber — they are never automatic and never block a prescription.

chain.cardSubtitle: The append-only hash chain, verified by replay. 'Verify now' re-runs the existing check and changes nothing.

reconcile.title: Reconciliation
reconcile.cardSubtitle: The most recent run of the launch-blocker reconciliation monitor.
reconcile.alarm: A reconciliation alarm is set for a period that has not since passed. Billing must reconcile to the unit before real invoicing.

ai.title: AI interactions
ai.cardSubtitle: Interaction outcomes and cost from the append-only ledger over the last {days} days.
ai.none: No AI interactions in this window.

kill.title: AI kill switches
kill.subtitle: Features an admin has disabled fail-closed.

security.title: Security-relevant events
security.subtitle: Role changes, overrides and other sensitive audit actions.

activity.title: Governance activity
activity.note: Recent audit events — append-only, displayed and never editable.

aiQueue.title: Approval queue
aiQueue.subtitle: Every agent action is suggest-only — a human approves or rejects before anything happens.
aiQueue.empty: No AI actions are awaiting review.

chrome.noneForFilter: No pending actions for this agent.

flash.approved: Action approved and executed through the existing path.
flash.approved_edited: Your edited action was approved and posted through the same gate — recorded as human-edited.
flash.fence_refused: The electric fence refused this action — nothing was posted. It is recorded as fence-refused.

bulk.selectOne: Select this action for bulk approve
bulk.note: Low-risk actions only — clinical and financial drafts always need individual review.
bulk.summary: Bulk approve: {approved} approved · {excluded} excluded (clinical/financial — individual review only) · {skipped} skipped.

edit.title: Edit the payload before it posts
edit.help: Your edit is the content posted through the gate. On approve the server still re-authorises you against {permission} and re-grounds/re-derives against current state before it posts — and records the post as human-edited. An edit is not a bypass.
edit.invalidJson: This is not valid JSON — fix it before approving.

card.noSources: No linked sources on this action.
card.contractDraft: On approve, the server re-authorises you against {permission} and re-grounds the draft against current state before it posts.
card.contractAction: On approve, the server re-authorises you against {permission} and re-derives the action against current state before it runs.

actions.reasonLabel: Reason for rejecting · recorded on the action
actions.noPermission: You do not hold the permission this tool requires, so you cannot review this action.

resolved.title: Recently resolved
resolved.subtitle: Approved, rejected, and fence-refused actions (read-only) — search and filter the real record.
resolved.noneForFilters: No resolved actions match these filters.

kb.title: Knowledge base
kb.subtitle: The articles the Front-Desk agent answers patient questions from. Curate the content here; the agent's grounding and refusals are unchanged.
kb.grounding: The Front-Desk agent grounds its answers only on ACTIVE articles, always with a citation, and refuses medical questions. Deactivating an article removes it from what the agent can answer from.

flash.activated: Article activated — the agent can ground on it again.
flash.deactivated: Article deactivated — the agent no longer grounds on it.

new.title: New article
new.subtitle: A new active article is immediately available to the agent.

list.title: Articles
list.subtitle: Active articles are the agent's source; inactive ones are kept but not grounded on.

staffTelehealth.title: Telehealth
staffTelehealth.subtitle: Your active and upcoming video visits. Join issues a short-lived, single-use token — media never touches CareOS.
staffTelehealth.notRecorded: None of these calls are recorded. The video room is not the clinical record — document the visit in a note like any other encounter.
staffTelehealth.joined: Token issued — connecting you to the video room. This call is not recorded.
staffTelehealth.empty: You have no active or upcoming telehealth sessions.

dentalIndex.title: Dental
dentalIndex.subtitle: Pick a patient to open their dental chart — charting, procedures, treatment plan, perio, diagnosis and imaging.
dentalIndex.searchHint: Full-text match on first and family name · date of birth matches exactly · results cap at 25.

dental.title: Odontogram
dental.readOnly: You can view the chart but not record — dental.chart required.
dental.clickHint: Click a tooth to inspect it and record what you observe.

legend.title: Chart key
legend.note: Colour marks the condition the dentist charted — not its severity. Nothing here is scored, graded, or flagged.

dental.selectPrompt: Select a tooth to see its charted conditions and history.
dental.reasonPlaceholder: Reason, if correcting a prior record (optional)
dental.noHistory: No charting history for this tooth.

perform.title: Perform a procedure
perform.hint: Records the procedure, captures the charge, and updates the chart — in one action.

perio.title: Perio charting
perio.subtitle: Six-point probing per tooth. Record the raw measurements you read on the probe.
perio.fenceNote: These are raw measurements only — pocket depth and recession in mm, bleeding on probing, and (optional) mobility and furcation. Nothing here is staged, graded, scored, or flagged. You read the numbers and interpret them.

newExam.title: Record a perio exam
newExam.subtitle: A re-exam is a new record — prior exams are kept.

exams.legend: Each site shows pocket depth / recession in mm; a dot marks bleeding on probing. Raw values as recorded.

diagnosis.title: Diagnosis
diagnosis.subtitle: Record your clinical diagnosis. You author it; this screen records it.
diagnosis.fenceNote: You write the diagnosis. Nothing here suggests, proposes, ranks, or auto-fills a diagnosis, and no diagnosis is derived from the charting, perio, or imaging. The status is your determination.

record.title: Record a diagnosis
record.subtitle: Pick from your own list or write free text — either way, it is yours.
record.label: Diagnosis
record.reason: Reason, if changing a prior diagnosis (optional)

terms.title: Your diagnosis list
terms.subtitle: Your own terms, for convenience. Not a coded set, not ranked, not suggested.
terms.empty: No terms yet — add your own, or just use free text above.

imaging.title: Imaging & scans
imaging.subtitle: Upload an image, view it, and write your reading.
imaging.fenceNote: This is a viewer. The system does not analyse images — no AI, no auto-findings, no overlay, no caries or pathology detection. You read the image and write the interpretation. Live capture (X-ray sensor / intraoral scanner), DICOM, and 3D scan overlay are not part of this release.

upload.title: Upload an image
upload.subtitle: JPEG or PNG, up to 10 MB. Stored privately, tied to this patient.

reading.title: Your reading
reading.placeholder: Write your interpretation of this image…
reading.reasonPlaceholder: Reason, if correcting a prior reading (optional)

feeSchedule.title: Fee schedule
feeSchedule.subtitle: Your own dental procedure list and fees. Each procedure is a billable item — charging it runs through the standard billing engine (invoice, reconciliation, dunning). You author your own codes and fees; nothing licensed is bundled.

flash.updated: Procedure updated. Past charges keep the fee they were captured at.
flash.seeded: Starter template added. Edit the codes and fees to match your practice.

list.title: Procedures
list.subtitle: Active procedures are chargeable; a fee edit never changes a charge already captured.
list.empty: No procedures yet. Add your own, or start from a generic template.

feeSchedule.name: Name
feeSchedule.toothScopedHint: Tooth-scoped — this procedure applies to a specific tooth/surface (e.g. a filling)

new.title: Add a procedure
new.subtitle: Your own code and fee — a new active procedure is immediately chargeable.

treatmentPlan.title: Treatment plans
treatmentPlan.subtitle: Proposed procedures grouped into phases, with an estimate from your fee schedule. You author the plan; the patient accepts it. Estimating is not billing — a procedure is charged only when it's performed.

flash.performed: Procedure recorded and charged; the plan item is marked done.

treatmentPlan.fenceNote: You author this plan — nothing is auto-suggested. Estimates come from your fee schedule.
treatmentPlan.noProcedures: Add procedures to your fee schedule first.

portalTreatmentPlan.title: Treatment plan
portalTreatmentPlan.subtitle: The treatment your dental team has proposed, with an estimate. This is an estimate — your dentist will confirm costs.
portalTreatmentPlan.empty: You have no treatment plans yet.

catalog.title: Imaging exam catalog
catalog.subtitle: Your own imaging exam menu — codes, modality, body part and contrast you author.
catalog.author: Author an exam
catalog.name: Name
catalog.fenceHint: The exam catalog records modality and body part — reference data the team reads. The system never computes an image finding, CAD read or abnormality flag; the radiologist authors the report.
catalog.empty: No imaging exams yet. Add one, or seed the starter set.

orders.title: Imaging orders
orders.noExams: No active imaging exams. Author the catalog first.
orders.priorityHint: Priority is the flag you set — the system never computes a priority or ranks orders by urgency.

worklist.title: Modality worklist
worklist.subtitle: Imaging orders awaiting acquisition. Shown as facts — the system never ranks by a computed priority.

study.title: Imaging study
study.acquireHint: An accession number is generated on acquisition — a unique study identifier (a fact).
study.noStudy: No study yet. Acquire it from the order.
study.imageSeamNote: Image storage and viewing (DICOM/PACS) are provided by a certified imaging partner and are not available here. This is the study record (metadata) — not a diagnostic viewer.

report.title: Radiology report
report.author: Author the report
report.findingsPlaceholder: Findings (what you observe in the images) — your words
report.fenceHint: You author the report. The system reads no images and computes no finding, CAD, abnormality flag or diagnosis — every word is yours.
report.noStudy: No acquired study yet — acquire the study before reporting.
report.routedNote: On signing, the report routes to the ordering clinician’s review worklist (the shared order → review flow).

billing.title: Radiology billing
billing.subtitle: Price the exam, capture the charge, and invoice — through the shared billing engine.
billing.priceHint: The price is a tenant-authored tariff — a rate, never driven by the report or findings. The engine computes every total.
billing.inpatientNote: For an admitted patient, imaging charges join the stay or episode invoice automatically — no order-level invoice.
